sections.title: Games
sections.note: Tip: open a game in Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen" to play full screen and offline.

items.name: Hanoi
items.description: Move the tower, one disc at a time. Earn stars, coins and themes.

items.name: Dodge
items.description: Dodge meteors, grab coins, unlock animal friends.

items.name: Color Sort
items.description: Sort the balls so every tube holds one color. 30 levels, stars and themes.

items.name: Block Pop
items.description: Drag blocks onto the grid, fill rows and columns to pop them. Chase your best score.

sections.title: Fitness
sections.note: Tip: open it in Safari, tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen" so it runs full screen, keeps the screen on and works offline.

items.name: Park Workout
items.description: Workout timer: routines for every goal, levels 1 to 10, rounds and rest, voice cues.
